text:
alex: Quick sync re: HydraBank Private POC. Req: Private deploy, stable egress IPs, TLS inspection compatibility, and ability to see client cert fields/ALPN. They want guidance: VPC peering vs PrivateLink + minimal firewall checklist + ballpark 30-day Dedicated POC pricing. @maria @jonah please?

maria: TL;DR: Peering = straight L3, preserves source IP + TLS. PrivateLink = endpoint -> our NLB -> SNAT. If client cert passthrough or ALPN matters, prefer peering.

jonah: Practical checklist snippets: 
- VPC peering: add route 10.60.0.0/16 -> pcx-xxxx, SG allow inbound from 10.60.0.0/16:443, ensure no CIDR overlap, NACL allow ephemeral 1024-65535.
- PrivateLink: customer creates interface endpoint(s); we publish NLB svc. SGs: allow from endpoint SGs; note source IPs will be our ENIs/EIPs.

jonah: Firewall example for their on-prem proxy: "ALLOW TCP 443 from 10.60.0.0/16 to sg-redwood". If using PrivateLink and they need predictable egress, we can route outbound via a small NAT fleet with static EIPs (extra cost).

sam: Security Qs to prefill: data retention policy, support for customer-managed KMS/HSM (Private only), audit log delivery (S3/syslog), cert handling under TLS inspection, compliance certifications (SOC2/ISO). Note: TLS MITM will strip client certs/ALPN behavior can change. Recommend an in-lab test.

alex: Pricing (very rough): 4 GPU-equivalent Dedicated nodes (30d) ~ $18k/mo list, one-time POC setup + priority = ~$5k, NAT/EIP fleet ~ $1.5k/mo. Hosted+PrivateLink cheaper on infra but loses source IPs.

maria: Ops caveats: peering needs approvals and non-overlapping CIDR; PrivateLink may hit endpoint quota (ask them to pre-request); TLS inspection requires lab verification.

alex: Action items: jonah draft 1-page route/SG/NACL/EIP checklist; sam draft security questionnaire answers; maria confirm HSM support and lead time.

infra-bot: ticket #POC-9347 created (HydraBank Private POC network + security checklist) assigned to jonah,maria,sam. ETA 48h.

alex: I'll forward to their netops and schedule a lab window for TLS inspection test.
